# Multi-Entity Group

`admin.model.multi_entity` · model · parent `—`

> A group of legal entities, often across jurisdictions, administered together. Every statutory obligation multiplies by entity and no two calendars align, which makes the filing and registration disciplines the spine of the whole function.

|  |  |
|---|---|

| committee_size | 3-6 approvers, per entity |
| decision_style | entity-by-entity, with a group policy overlay |
